Keep the ENOENT silence, the other arguments (paths/ids), and `return null;` exactly as they are. Change nothing else.

Then grep tests/ for each file's basename and run those with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test <files>; confirm green. One-line summary per file.
